question: Do measured exposures precede recalled adult-worst outcomes?
evidence_type: Primary peer-reviewed cross-sectional study; original methods audit

items.verified: Childhood worst period must be before 18; adult worst at least 18 and no later than assessment; retrospective ratings collected at survey.
items.not_established: Prospectively measured baseline severity; independent contemporary childhood rater; out-of-sample predictive performance.

items.verified: Methods assign lifetime diagnosis from adapted symptom/severity criteria. Discussion refers to childhood OCD.
items.not_established: Published model uses a childhood-only diagnosis or onset before adult-worst tics. Do not replace lifetime with childhood.

items.verified: Lifetime diagnosis uses retrospective childhood symptoms plus onset and impairment criteria; severity-model p=.82.
items.not_established: Prospective predictor assessment, absence of all ADHD effects, equivalence or transportability.

items.verified: Medication status is current at survey; impairment coefficient 4.76, p=.020. Authors discuss treatment seeking with greater impairment.
items.not_established: Medication preceding the recalled worst period, a causal harmful or beneficial treatment effect, or untreated natural history.

items.verified: Retrospective question concerns event at adult-worst tic period. Severity-model p=.098; impairment-model p=.0078. Positive valence associations not significant for either outcome.
items.not_established: Event onset before worsening, a causal trigger or evidence that avoiding events prevents tics. Personal event descriptions were not retained.

items.verified: 50 people reuse current six-month scores as adult-worst.
items.not_established: Independent repeated observation or validation of the retrospective outcome.

model_documentation.selection: Candidate predictors selected from age-adjusted single-predictor models at p<.1; childhood score included.
model_documentation.ocd_impairment_threshold_note: Table bolding/narrative claim significance while footnote defines p<.05. Rounded display cannot adjudicate unrounded threshold; preserved without correction.
model_documentation.missing_data_rule: No explicit outcome-specific complete-case/imputation rule located in inspected methods/tables.
model_documentation.validation: No held-out validation, calibration or external predictive performance located in the inspected paper. Reported R-squared is not established out-of-sample accuracy.

decision: Retain retrospective association evidence; no verified prospective risk model or causal medication effect. Stop at missing documentation rather than infer model denominators.
